question.problem:
Which of the following determinants are equal to $0?$

$$
|A|=|\begin{aligned}3 & 0 & 0 \\ \sqrt{3} & -6 & 0 \\ \sqrt{5} & 8 & 2\end{aligned}|,\,|B|=|\begin{aligned}1 & \sqrt{2} & 4 \\ 2 & 2\sqrt{2} & 8 \\ 0 & -\sqrt{3} & 4\end{aligned}|,\,|C|=|\begin{aligned}-1 & \sqrt{3} & 4 \\ 0 & 3 & \sqrt{3} \\ 0 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}|.
$$
question.worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the given determinants in turn.

- The matrix $A$ is a triangular matrix, hence 

$$
|A|=3\cdot (-6)\cdot 2=-36\ne 0.
$$

- The matrix $B$ has proportional rows: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}1 & \sqrt{2} & 4 \\ 2 & 2\sqrt{2} & 8 \\ 0 & -\sqrt{3} & 4\end{aligned}]
$$

As a result, $|B|=0.$

- The matrix $C$ is a triangular matrix, hence 

$$
|C|=(-1)\cdot 3\cdot 4=-12\ne 0
$$

Therefore, only $|B|$ is equal to $0.$
